mission_10: Congratulations on completing the Federated Learning chapter! You have built a comprehensive understanding of FL from FedAvg to security defenses. You implemented the core aggregation algorithm, secure aggregation for privacy, differential privacy for mathematical guarantees, personalization techniques for heterogeneous clients, FedProx for stability, communication compression for efficiency, non-IID data handling, cross-silo orchestration, a complete FL framework, and security mechanisms against poisoning attacks. This knowledge prepares you to design, implement, and deploy real-world federated learning systems that respect user privacy while delivering powerful collaborative AI. The techniques you learned are actively used in healthcare, finance, mobile computing, and IoT applications worldwide.
